skill.summary: Web dashboard for real-time monitoring and management of OpenClaw subagents. Use when monitoring or managing subagents.

latestVersion.changelog:
Subagent Dashboard 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Introduces a web dashboard for real-time monitoring and management of OpenClaw subagents.
- Displays all sessions, agent details, role badges, task progress, and transcript viewing.
- Features real-time updates and detection of stalled agents.
- Integrates with subagent-tracker for data and supports completed task tracking.
- Simple installation and usage through Flask web server.
